lines.en: Crack, bones grinding.
Whale moves, bones scrape.

lines.zh: 残骨摇曳，如海怪般游动。
lines.en: Rattling bones, moving like a sea beast.
Sibilant bones drift.
Bones clink together.

lines.zh: 巨骨碰撞，发出沉闷声响。
lines.en: Large bones clash, making dull sounds.
Bones grind, making creaking sounds.
Large bones move slowly.

lines.zh: 骨块碰撞，发出响亮声音。
lines.en: Bone chunks clack loudly.
Bones creak as they move.
Staring at the bottom, silent.
Lying in fragments, waiting for prey.
Empty gaze, silent.
Drifting bones, pondering.
Staring into the abyss, silent.

lines.zh: 孤独的骨架，静静地漂浮。
lines.en: Lonely bones, drifting quietly.
Silent large bones, drifting.
Drifting broken bones, waiting.
Empty eyes, silent.
Drifting bones, silent.

lines.zh: 蓝骨在冰水里轻轻碰撞。
lines.en: Blue bones click softly in the icy water.

lines.zh: 我半沉的骨架卡在冰层下。
lines.en: My half-sunk frame lodges under the ice.

lines.zh: 冰面下，我的尾骨慢慢摆。
lines.en: Beneath the ice my tailbone sways.

lines.zh: 我缺了一半身子，仍能游。
lines.en: Half my body is gone and I still swim.

lines.zh: 冰层自己裂开，给我让路。
lines.en: The ice splits on its own to let me pass.
I count the undercurrents beneath the ice.
Noticing you, staring for a moment.
Detecting you, becoming alert.
Fixing you in sight, waiting.

lines.zh: 你被盯上了，警惕心上升。
lines.en: You're being watched, alertness rising.

lines.zh: 你出现在视野中，它开始移动。
lines.en: You're in its view, it starts moving.
You're detected, it prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它注意到了你，准备攻击。
lines.en: It notices you, preparing to attack.
It stares at you, ready to act.

lines.zh: 你引起了它的注意，它准备攻击。
lines.en: You caught its attention, it's ready to attack.

lines.zh: 你被它盯上了，它准备行动。
lines.en: You're being watched, it's ready to act.
In the ice glare, I fix on you.
My hollow sockets swing toward you.
Blue bones cracking, pain unbearable!
Bones breaking, hurts!
So brittle, ow!
Rattling bones, hurts!
Blue whale bones, hurts!

lines.zh: 这伤，真不是一点两点的疼！
lines.en: This hurt, really more than just a little!
Bones about to break, hurts!
Blue bones breaking, hurts!
Bones about to splinter, hurts!
This hurt, driving me mad!
Beneath the ice water, I open my mouth.
My bones are colder than ice!
Dare to eat my bones?
I am the king beneath the ice!
Bone storm coming!
You've touched forbidden ground.
The ice-buried king of creatures.

lines.zh: 我的存在，冻结了这片海域。
lines.en: My presence freezes the sea.
My icebound realm, my domain!

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，弄脏了我的冰。
lines.en: Your body heat soils my ice.

lines.zh: 不要碰我，你会受到伤害！
lines.en: Don't touch me, you'll get hurt!

lines.zh: 你的身体无法承受撞击！
lines.en: Your body can't withstand the impact!
Bone shattering, pain unbearable!

lines.zh: 冰块碰撞，粉碎你的世界！
lines.en: Ice collision, shatter your world!
My bones, indestructible!
Bone chunks collide, crush all!
Collide with me, and face death!
Ice fortress, unbreakable!
My bones, like sharp blades.

lines.zh: 撞击只会加剧我的愤怒。
lines.en: Collisions only anger me more.

lines.zh: 寻找我的同伴，一起繁衍！
lines.en: Find my mate, and procreate!

lines.zh: 冰下深处，寻找我的灵魂伴侣。
lines.en: Find my soulmate beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我是冰极维度的统治者。
lines.en: I am the ruler of the ice dimension.

lines.zh: 我们的结合，将更加强大。
lines.en: Our union will be powerful.

lines.zh: 只有最强者才能成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: Only the strongest can be my mate.

lines.zh: 冰下深处，我的领地，我的爱。
lines.en: My ice realm, my love beneath the ice.
I am Kitra, the aquatic king.
The ice-buried king of creatures
Ice dimension, my home.

lines.zh: 我的存在，是这片海域的灵魂。
lines.en: My presence is the soul of this sea.

lines.zh: 我在这里守护着冰极维度的奥秘。
lines.en: Guarding the mysteries of the Ice Dimension.
You'll pay for your proximity.

lines.zh: 那根骨头，不是给你玩的。
lines.en: That bone isn't for you to play with.

lines.zh: 我的骨头会破碎你的心。
lines.en: My bones will shatter your heart.
Ice shards are my weapons.

lines.zh: 冰极维度中只有死神与我为伴。
lines.en: Only death and I roam the Ice Dimension.
I won't die easily.
There's my domain beneath the ice.
You've invaded my world.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是对你的警告。
lines.en: My presence is a warning to you.
My trap has caught its prey.
Your end is near.
My leftover blue bones glow.
I've locked onto your position.
The blue-boned whale rises to the ice.
I'll enjoy the hunt.

lines.zh: 我来了，准备迎接死亡吧。
lines.en: I'm here, prepare to meet your doom.
Your struggles are meaningless.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是你的噩梦。
lines.en: My existence is your nightmare.
You're the first.
You cracked my ice.

lines.zh: 血肉的味道，穿过冰水来了。
lines.en: The smell of flesh crosses the meltwater.
Another living thing in my frozen realm.
My bone bolts will split you eight ways.
You stand in the middle of my hunting ground.
The ice tells me where you are.
I can count every step you take.
You are marked; don't stop.
I'm about to show my power.

lines.zh: 冰面裂开，我从底下上来。
lines.en: The ice splits; I rise from underneath.

lines.zh: 你的命运掌握在我手中。
lines.en: Your fate is in my hands.

lines.zh: 死亡将是你唯一的归宿。
lines.en: Death will be your only home.
The bone fork flies out and splits eight ways.
Ice spikes will pierce your body.

lines.zh: 你的哀嚎将回荡在这片冰原。
lines.en: Your screams will echo across this ice plain.
I'll crush your will.
Your pain is my joy.
Ice wrath is about to erupt.
My bolt leaves and breaks into eight.
Come close and the cold bites first.
I circle once and the ice gives way.
My bolt hits stone and bursts like stars.

lines.zh: 你躲左边，右边也有一片。
lines.en: Dodge left and the right is still covered.

lines.zh: 冰在碎，你的退路也在碎。
lines.en: The ice breaks, and so does your way out.
I lift my tail and the sea freezes.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在寒气里变脆。
lines.en: Your armor turns brittle in the cold.
Eight bone shards orbit around you.
I stay under; my bolts fly above.
Bones collide, cold spreads.
Hisses, shatters on contact.
Feel my power.
Bone claws pierce your defense.
In the ice, my power grows.
You can't withstand my fury.
Swallow your ice curse.
Bone shards, my weapons.
Death by proximity.
Ice rage, sweeping all.
Bone strikes you and ice chips fly.

lines.zh: 我用残骨拍碎你的立足处。
lines.en: My broken ribs smash your footing.

lines.zh: 你被寒气拖慢半步，够了。
lines.en: The cold slows you half a step; enough.
This blow webs the ice with cracks.
Frozen lands, my throne.
Deep ocean floor, my home.
Cold winds, my call.
Ice giant, descends.
Icebound, my avatar.
Ice spirit, appears here.
Ice lord, arriving soon.
Ice king, awakens.
Frozen lands, my home.

lines.zh: 寒冰之王，现身冰封之地。
lines.en: Ice king, appears in frozen lands.

lines.zh: 冰极的海底，我翻了个身。
lines.en: On the frozen seafloor I turn over.
Blue bones rise from under the ice.
I shoulder through floes and show my skull.
This sea: I have returned.

lines.zh: 冰柱一根根折断，我到了。
lines.en: Ice pillars snap one by one; I have come.

lines.zh: 我的骨节在深水里咔响。
lines.en: My joints creak in the deep water.
The frozen wind woke me.
Half a whale's frame glides out of the dark.
I burst through the ice and water pours in.
A silent giant of bone surfaces.

lines.zh: 火苗舔舐着我的蓝骨，疼！
lines.en: Fire burns my blue bones, hurts!
Fall from the sky, bones crack!
Too long in water, bones rot!
Explosion tears my blue bones, hurts!
Hit by bone shard, hurts!

lines.zh: 魔法术士的咒语伤我蓝骨，疼！
lines.en: Wizard's spell hurts my blue bones!

lines.zh: 饥饿使我虚弱，蓝骨颤抖！
lines.en: Starvation weakens me, blue bones tremble!
Lightning strikes my blue bones, hurts!
Void tears my blue bones!
